svg.title: FinPay API architecture diagram
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: client layer at top, middleware pipeline in middle, data layer at bottom. Shows request flow through JWT auth, rate limiter, idempotency check, Redis cache, service layer, and PostgreSQL database.

g.text: All inbound requests enter here · Morgan request logging · Winston structured output

svg.text: Middleware pipeline — every request passes through in order

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain how JWT authentication works in the FinPay API middleware pipeline')
g.text: Validates Bearer token · rejects 401 if missing or expired · attaches userId to request

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the three-tier rate limiting in FinPay — global, auth, and transaction limiters')
g.text: Global 100/15min · strict auth limiter · per-user transaction cap · counters in Redis

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain how idempotency keys work in FinPay — the Stripe pattern for duplicate payment prevention')
g.text: Redis lookup · hit → return cached response · miss → continue · key stored in Redis + DB

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the Redis cache layer in FinPay — which endpoints are cached and why')
g.text: Read-heavy endpoints: account balance, transaction history · hit → early return, no DB

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the service layer in FinPay — what business logic runs here')
g.text: Auth · account management · atomic money transfers via Prisma $transaction · audit logging

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the PostgreSQL schema in FinPay — users, accounts, transactions, and audit_logs tables')
sendPrompt('Explain how Redis is used in FinPay — rate limiting, caching, and idempotency key TTL')
